title: Tradoor.fun
tagline: Tradoor.fun - Your AI-powered trading companion. Get real-time market analysis, portfolio insights, and trading suggestions while maintaining full control over your execution decisions.
description:
Tradoor.fun is a responsible trading assistant platform that combines the Coinbase API's market data capabilities with AI analysis to provide traders with informed insights. The platform focuses on:

Market Analysis: Real-time data processing and pattern recognition
Risk Management: Portfolio analysis and exposure monitoring
Educational Components: Teaching users about market dynamics
Trading Suggestions: AI-powered analysis with human oversight
Compliance Focus: Operating within regulatory frameworks

The key differentiator is that all trading decisions and executions remain under direct human control, ensuring compliance and responsible trading practices.
how_its_made:
The platform is built using a modern tech stack that prioritizes security, reliability, and regulatory compliance:
Frontend:

React.js for the user interface
TailwindCSS for styling
WebSocket integration for real-time data

Backend:

Node.js/Express for the API layer
MongoDB for data persistence
Redis for caching and real-time data handling

Integration:

Coinbase API for market data and trading interface
JWT for secure authentication
WebSocket secure (WSS) for real-time updates
